identity.description: An attacker uses arp.exe to enumerate the ARP cache on a Windows host, potentially to map network topology or identify targets. Cortex should detect the unusual invocation of arp.exe with specific flags that deviate from normal behavior.

biocs.name: Uncommon ARP Cache Listing
biocs.description: Detection of arp.exe being invoked with flags that indicate network reconnaissance or enumeration
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\arp.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-a' or action_process_command_line contains '-g' or action_process_command_line contains '-d'
